messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Lighthouse pilot: quota uplift & traffic orchestration

Team —

Lighthouse (Alicia copied below) is greenlit for a 6-week pilot starting 12/16. They expect a phased ramp that could hit short-term peaks higher than our default per-account ingress. Ask: can we provision a temporary quota uplift + short warmup path to avoid hard throttles during the first 72 hours of the pilot?

Key details from the customer (summary attached):
- Expected baseline: 8 rps steady (concurrent gen requests), short spikes up to ~55 rps for 10–15m windows during scheduled batch tests.
- Typical payload: 1–2k tokens per request (mix of streaming and non-streaming).
- Pilot objective: validate latency SLO and A/B routing between quantized and full-precision models.

What I need from you:
1) Karthik/Infra: feasibility on a temporary quota increase (target: 70 rps burst, 8 rps baseline) and recommended canary windows + fallback model variants.
2) Priya/Product: any UI/feature gating we should toggle for the pilot (rollout stickiness, KV caching warmups).
3) Neha/Capacity: impact to committable capacity and whether this can be handled within Dedicated pools or needs Hosted fallback.
4) Monica/CS: coordinate the customer-runbook and confirm the test schedule.

I've attached a quick forecast (lighthouse_traffic_forecast.xlsx) and a draft mutual action plan. Please reply with your constraints and an expected ETA for a decision.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse pilot: quota uplift & traffic orchestration

Sean —

Quick feasibility note from the runtime side: temporary quota bump is doable, but we have a few guardrails to protect latency SLOs across tenants. High-level constraints and recommendations: 

1) Model variants: recommend routing spikes to q4_8bit variants for the first 48 hours of the pilot, with an automatic fallback to fp16-only for mission-critical flows if we detect >20% latency regression. We can stage this via a rollout policy.

2) KV cache warmup: for repeated prefixes we can pre-warm KV segments; will need the list of heavy prefixes from Lighthouse. Suggest a 2-hour warmup window before each scheduled test burst.

3) Batching: continuous batching thresholds should be increased for their pilot during the scheduled bursts; will reduce per-token cost and keep tail latency bounded. Requires minor config changes (INF-2147).

4) Autoscaling: if they hit sustained >40 rps for >30m we will autoscale but initial capacity needs to be reserved to avoid cold starts. Neha — confirm if we can reserve a small burst slice in Dedicated for 12/16–12/18.

ETA: I can have the canary + rollout config ready for staging by EOD 12/10 if Priya signs off on routing policy and we get the prefixes.

Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime

Team — quick commercial/context note:

- Pilot cadence: Lighthouse wants a white-glove pilot; they're measuring latency and cost-per-call. We agreed to evaluate a one-time quota uplift for the first three days with a time-boxed rate plan to avoid indefinite exposure.
- Pricing ask: they're requesting a temporary credit if tail latency exceeds the SLA during the pilot — I'll handle the commercial wording, but we need technical confirmation on fallback behavior so we don't promise something we can't deliver.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Pre-run checklist (12/14–12/15): prefixes, test payloads, accepted SLOs, runbook link.
2) Warmup run (12/16 02:00–04:00 PT): low-volume warmups + KV prefill.
3) Pilot bursts (12/16–12/18): scheduled tests at 11:00 and 16:00 PT each day. We allow up to 70 rps for 15m windows during the tests.
4) Canary & rollback windows: traffic routed to q4_8bit by default during bursts with a 30-minute canary and automatic rollback on error-rate or latency threshold.

Please confirm the above and flag any blockers by COB tomorrow so I can lock the wording in the contract amendment.

Laura
VP, Sales
(attachment: hubspot_LH-47_export.csv - csv)

Subject: Re: Lighthouse pilot: quota uplift & traffic orchestration

Thanks Sean — Alicia here (Lighthouse Eng lead). A few clarifications from our end: 

- The spikes are tied to scheduled batch imports and a user-facing bulk preview tool. Spikes are predictable and we can provide exact timestamps for the test windows.
- Token distribution: ~60% of calls are ~900 tokens, 30% are 1.8k tokens, 10% streaming exploratory sessions.
- We absolutely want the pilot to default to the cheaper variant during bursts (q4_8bit) as long as the output fidelity is within acceptable bounds.

We can provide:
- a CSV of sample payload prefixes (will drop in the Drive folder by EOD 12/11),
- a confirmed schedule for 12/16–12/18 (two 15m bursts per day at our local times),
- a runbook contact list for on-call.

Happy to sync tomorrow morning if that helps.

Alicia Gomez
Senior Engineering Manager, Lighthouse Health

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation of decisions and owners: 

1) Quota bump: temporary burst allowance to 70 rps (15m windows) approved for 12/16–12/18. Owner: Neha to reserve Dedicated burst pool. ETA: confirm by 12/11 18:00 PT.
2) Routing & fallback: route bursts to q4_8bit for first 48h; automatic rollback to fp16 on latency or error triggers. Owner: Karthik. ETA: staging config by 12/10 EOD (Karthik).
3) KV warmups: Alicia will drop prefixes into Drive; Karthik to run pre-warm on 12/16 01:00–03:00 PT. Owner: Alicia (provide list) + Karthik (execute).
4) Commercials: Laura will add pilot credit language to the amendment, time-boxed to the three-day warm window. Owner: Laura.
5) Runbook & On-call: Monica to own runbook updates and provide a Redwood contact list to Lighthouse. Owner: Monica.

Related artifacts: lighthouse_traffic_forecast.xlsx, LH_mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf, HubSpot record LH-47, INF-2147 (canary config).

If anyone sees a blocking issue with the ETA stated above, flag it in this thread now. Otherwise I'll open the canary PR and add the runbook link to the Drive folder.
